key_insight: A coarse-grained reduction connects dynamic strain aging in propagating Portevin–Le Chatelier bands to ABBM avalanche dynamics through tensile-machine feedback.
engineering_relevance: The framework links intermittent plastic-band motion to material hardening and machine feedback, helping interpret unstable deformation during tensile loading.
method: Reduce a propagating band to one phase coordinate while retaining elastic machine feedback.
Compute band stress mobility with a finite-time adjoint and check it by direct stress continuation.
Map short-range fluctuations in deposited plastic strain to a Brownian effective force through global feedback.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement between adjoint and stress-continuation mobility estimates, with mobility approximately proportional to hardening and band speed scaling approximately as its square root.
watch_item: The reduction targets propagating type-A bands; applicability to other PLC regimes or experimental conditions is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: From dynamic strain aging to Alessandro--Beatrice--Bertotti--Montorsi dynamics of propagating Portevin--Le Chatelier bands
